name: devflow
description: Everyday checkpoints for coding agents: tldr (session or question summary), ask (read-only questions), changes-review (review and fix unpushed changes before you push), stepwise (step-by-step plans that keep track of where you are), spec (one-screen spec before coding a non-trivial task), adr (record decisions with real alternatives as ADRs), tests-audit (tell real test failures from false reds and false greens), qa-check (test what you changed against the requirement: missing tests, real flow, release verdict), security-audit (source-first security audit of your changes or the whole repo, reporting only real trust-boundary failures) and focus (answer-first replies: next action first, no filler).
